text:
June Park: quick heads-up — ran attention kernel sweep across H100 / A100 / L40S on commit f2e9c3. observed the kernel selector flip to `paged_fused` at seq=2048+ and bsz 4/8 on H100 and a ~35% drop in tokens/sec compared to flash_v2. h100: 720 -> 470 tok/s (bsz=8, seq=4096). p99 latency up ~2.1x. nvprof shows memcpy stalls aligned with KV prefetch window.

Max Chen: can you paste the exact bench command and a short diff of selector logs?

June Park: ran with:
```
./bench_runner --model llama-2-13b --devices h100,a100,l40s --seqs 128,512,1024,2048,4096 --bsz 1,4,8 --kernel-policy auto --log-selector true
```
Selector log snippet: `policy chose paged_fused for seq>=2048 on target=h100 (est_cost=123, fallback=flash_v2 est_cost=98)`

Olivia R.: did you try forcing `flash_v2` to confirm it's selector-related vs runtime bug?

June Park: yes — forcing `flash_v2` on the same host recovered to ~690 tok/s (bsz=8, seq=4096). a100 numbers barely changed (650 -> 640), l40s no regression. so it's H100-specific.

PerfBot: note: rollout 2390012390 enabled experimental kernel selector on 10% of fleet at 2026-02-14T12:03:10Z.

Max Chen: my guess — the selector cost model underestimates device-to-device memcpy cost on newer H100 SM config. `paged_fused` trades compute for extra prefetch memcpy; on H100 that memcpy latency + PCIe/NVLink pattern here is killing throughput. also seeing KV cache miss rate spike (bsz>=4) — thrash increases memcpy frequency.

June Park: steps I'm taking: 1) rerun microprofiling with `nvprof --metrics gld_throughput,gst_throughput,dram_read_throughput` and collect flamegraphs; 2) tune prefetch window from 64->32; 3) run selector policy ablation (disable memcpy penalty) to reproduce cost model sensitivity. will post numbers in thread.

Olivia R.: filing a regression ticket and gating selector rollout. cc @eng-sre for canary hold.

Max Chen: if you need quick mitigation, pin runtime config to prefer `flash_v2` for H100 or limit paged_fused to seq>=8192 for now. also add a one-line change to selector to weight memcpy by device memory bandwidth.

June Park: thanks — re-running with prefetch=32 now. quick snapshot (after prefetch tune): h100 bsz=8 seq=4096 tok/s 470 -> 610, p99 down 2.1x -> 1.3x. still not fully restored but much better. I'll upload nvprof traces to /tmp/bench/2390012345/ and follow up with flamegraphs.

Max Chen: great, can you attach the selector decision matrix dump too? helps tune weights.

June Park: will do. next post will include traces + selector dump + short repro script.

Olivia R.: thanks all — keeping rollout paused until we confirm a fix. :thumbsup:
